newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman bank credit rises 18 percent last year.
newsitem.headline: Oman bank credit rises 18 percent last year.

text.p: Total credit extended by Omani commercial banks last year rose by more than 18 percent to 1.66 billion rials, the Central Bank said on Tuesday.
In a statement, the Bank said total credit extended in 1995 was 1.40 billion rials.

It said credit to the manufacturing sector rose by some 30 percent to 86.7 million rials from 65.2 million in 1995 "which reflects the sultanate's policy of giving more support and incentives to this sector and develop it in a way that meets private sector aspirations".
The Bank said personal loans still took the largest slice of bank credit -- at around a third of total credit extended or 552.8 million rials in 1996.
Oman, a small oil producer, is trying to encourage a bigger private sector role in the economy as part of plans to lessen dependence on oil.
